about: Learner-facing details for every part of the R10 (GTSIO-520-H) Explore card, one definition per kind of part. The 'student' block is what a learner may see once reviewed; the 'engineering' block is the GTSIO manual cross-check and the alignment result, and never ships to the browser. The IO-520 catalogue rows behind each alignment result are kept out of Git (the repository is public). Every definition stays 'draft' until the instructor has reviewed it.
